cframe: Where it is and how it is turned, relative to its parent.
visible: Off: it is not drawn, and queries skip it too.
pivot: The point it turns about, as an offset from its centre. A door turns at its hinge this way.
alwaysRelevant: Every player receives it whatever the distance. Off: players only get what is near them.
locked: On: clicking, box and lasso selection in the viewport skip this part. It can still be picked in the Explorer.
owner: The player that simulates its physics. Empty means the server.
ambient: The light every face gets inside the viewport, whatever way it points.
lightColor: The colour of the viewport's one directional light.
lightDirection: Which way the viewport's light shines, as a direction.
updateRate: Times per second the viewport draws its 3D again. 0 draws every frame.
resolutionScale: Below 1 the viewport draws fewer pixels and looks blocky, above 1 it is sharper and costs more.
accepts: What a message may carry, in order: "string", "number, vec3?"... Empty means no arguments; anything else sent is refused.
Part.color: The colour it is drawn with.
anchored: On: physics never moves it, it stays exactly where it is placed. Off: it falls, gets pushed and rolls once the place plays.
collides: Off: bodies pass straight through it. A trigger pad is Collides off, Transparency 1, Can Touch on.
canQuery: Off: raycasts and spatial queries skip it.
canTouch: Off: it never fires touched or touchEnded.
collisionGroup: The collision group it belongs to. CollisionGroup instances say which groups pass through each other.
meshId: The model drawn in place of the box, a glTF, bbmodel or ammesh file.
animation: The clip of the model that plays.
animationSpeed: How fast the clip plays, 1 is normal speed.
animationLooped: On: the clip starts over when it ends.
LightSource.enabled: Off: the light gives no light.
temperature: A colour temperature in kelvin that tints the light. 0 keeps the colour as is.
range: How far the light reaches, in blocks.
falloff: How the light fades with distance.
falloffExponent: How sharply it fades for the exponent falloff.
shadows: On: things between the light and a surface block the light.
shadowStrength: How dark its shadows are, 0 to 1.
godrays: How strong the visible light shafts are.
innerAngle: The angle in degrees of the fully lit centre of the cone.
outerAngle: The angle in degrees where the cone fades to nothing.
soundId: The sound file or sound event to play.
pitch: 1 is normal, higher plays faster and higher.
looped: On: it starts over when it ends.
bus: The mixer bus the sound goes through.
minDistance: Closer than this it plays at full volume.
maxDistance: Further than this it is silent.
rollOff: How the volume drops between the two distances.
fadeIn: Seconds it takes to reach full volume when it starts.
stream: On: it streams from disk instead of loading whole, for long music.
Zone.size: Its dimensions. A sphere uses x as its diameter, a cylinder x as diameter and y as height.
trackPlayers: On: bodies players wear count as inside.
trackTag: Anything with this tag counts as inside.
trackClass: Anything of this class counts as inside.
cooldown: Seconds before the same thing can enter or leave again.
Zone.priority: Where zones overlap, the higher one wins.
textChannel: Players inside join this chat channel.
Zone.soundId: A sound players hear while inside.
Zone.volume: How loud the zone sound is.
mode: How the camera follows: scripted, first person or third person.
fov: Field of view in degrees. 0 keeps the player's own.
distance: How far behind the subject a third person camera sits.
offset: Shifts the camera from its subject.
subject: What the camera follows.
CameraPath.duration: Seconds from the first point to the last when played.
CameraPath.easing: How progress speeds up and slows down along the path.
CameraPath.direction: Which end of the path the easing applies to.
CameraPath.looped: Starts again from the beginning instead of finishing.
CameraPath.closed: Joins the last point back to the first, for orbits.
CameraPath.faceAlong: Looks along the path instead of turning between the points' own rotations.
CameraPath.lookAt: Keeps looking at this instance the whole way. Wins over faceAlong.
animationId: A res:// path to a .anim file. A KeyframeSequence inside the Animation is used instead when there is one.
AnimationTrack.animation: The Animation or KeyframeSequence this track plays.
AnimationTrack.speed: How fast the track plays. 1 is normal, negative plays backwards.
AnimationTrack.looped: Starts over at the end. The animation's own looped setting also loops it.
fadeTime: Seconds the track takes to blend in when played and out when stopped.
timePosition: Where the track is, in seconds. Not shared between the server and clients.
AnimationTrack.length: How long the animation is, in seconds.
KeyframeSequence.looped: Tracks playing this sequence start over at the end.
KeyframeSequence.priority: When tracks move the same joint, the highest priority wins.
Keyframe.time: When this keyframe is reached, in seconds from the start.
Pose.cframe: Where the joint named like this pose sits at this keyframe, relative to its rest.
Pose.easing: How the joint moves from this keyframe to the next one.
Pose.weight: How much of this pose is blended in, 0 to 1.
KeyframeMarker.value: Handed to getMarkerReachedSignal when the track passes this keyframe.
moveDirection: Which way the body is moving, flat and of length 1, or zero when still.
floorMaterial: The block under the feet, like minecraft:grass_block, or air.
sit: Sits the body. It can not walk, and jumping stands it up.
platformStand: Takes away walking and jumping, the body only moves when pushed.
autoRotate: Turns a body without a player to face where it walks.
healthRegen: Health gained each second while alive and hurt.
density: How heavy the part is for its size. Mass is density times volume.
friction: How much it grips what it slides on. 0 is ice.
elasticity: How much it bounces. 0 lands dead, 1 bounces back as high.
massless: Weighs nothing, so welding it to something does not make that heavier.
Part.velocity: How fast an unanchored part moves, in metres per second. Set it with setVelocity.
angularVelocity: How fast an unanchored part spins, in radians per second on each axis.
primaryPart: The part pivotTo and getPivot use, so the model moves about it.
Model.scale: The model's current scale. Change it with scaleTo, which also grows every part inside.
part1: The second part held together. It keeps its offset from part0 at the moment the weld starts.
attachment0: Where the constraint holds the first part. A hinge turns about this attachment's red X axis.
attachment1: Where the constraint holds the second part.
active: On while the constraint is really holding its parts. Off when a part is missing or both are anchored.
collideConnected: Lets the two connected parts still collide with each other.
actuatorType: None swings freely, motor spins at a speed, servo moves to a target.
HingeConstraint.angularVelocity: Motor speed in radians per second.
motorMaxTorque: How hard the motor may push.
angularSpeed: The fastest a servo turns, in radians per second.
servoMaxTorque: How hard the servo may push.
limitsEnabled: Stops the movement between the lower and upper values.
currentAngle: The angle the hinge is at now, in degrees.
PrismaticConstraint.velocity: Motor speed along the attachment's X axis, in metres per second.
targetPosition: Servo target along the axis, in metres.
currentPosition: How far along the axis it is now, in metres.
RopeConstraint.length: The rope is slack below this distance and taut at it.
freeLength: The length the spring rests at.
stiffness: How hard the spring pulls back, in newtons per metre.
damping: How quickly the spring stops bouncing.
SpawnLocation.enabled: Players can arrive here. With several enabled, each player picks one at random.
ViewportFrame.camera: The Camera the viewport looks through. Empty uses the first Camera inside it.
ViewportFrame.imageColor: Tints the drawn 3D, white leaves it as it is.
ViewportFrame.imageTransparency: 0 shows the drawn 3D fully, 1 hides it.
ClickDetector.maxActivationDistance: How far from its part, in blocks, a player can still hover and click it.
ClickDetector.cursorIcon: The cursor shown while a free pointer is over it: arrow, hand, text, crosshair, a res:// image. Empty shows a hand.
